status: implemented; technical checks passed; player visual feedback and formal idle performance acceptance remain open
rain_layer_followup: User reported rain strokes on clouds after this implementation; corrected and checked separately in rain-layer-review.json. The measurements below remain the prior rain-area phase's history.

implementation.data_field: weather_simulation.ground_rain stores fallen / dt for each cell during the latest fixed step; it is read-only display data and excluded from water accounting
implementation.visual: Two depth-projected GPU passes draw faint ground fill and a narrow contour visible through clouds; opaque clouds are unchanged. Rain lines and lift markers no longer write depth.
implementation.selection: The existing cloud ray pick locks cloud context for a gesture. Hovering or moving a cloud strengthens only its connected actual-rain region; focus returns over about 0.3 seconds.
implementation.shared_toggle: Weather hints jointly control movement/lift arrows and rain-area display. White wind lines, actual rain streaks and source markers remain. Default on; session choice survives retry, map and mode changes.

checks.full_regression: tests/run_checks.ps1 completed from the beginning, including 30 playthroughs and five star-route comparisons; all checks passed
checks.determinism: Two separately initialized simulations received identical input; toggling visual hints did not change humidity, cloud, rain, cold air, wind, target water or water error.
checks.route_timing_note: An earlier full-suite attempt had one timing-sensitive needs viewport route stop after a target flooded. Its isolated rerun passed, and the later complete final suite passed from the beginning. Logs remain under .godot/ for both runs.

performance_short_comparison.stress: cloud, rain and cold; idle and drag; drag keeps two sources (band plus vortex), arrows/wind-line workload, and active natural weather
performance_short_comparison.result: P99 stayed under 20 ms and no sample had a frame over 33 ms. P95 exceeded 16.7 ms in several two-source drag samples both with hints on and off; the enabled cases had up to 18.491 ms. This short comparison is a diagnostic, not the formal 60-second acceptance run.
performance_short_comparison.formal_idle_acceptance: deferred per the user's prior choice

preview_package: The Windows standalone preview was re-exported after implementation; see README for its .godot/WeavingRain-preview.zip location. This does not indicate a TapTap upload or review.
